name: Superseding existing accepted ADR when scale invalidates original decision
query: Six months ago we accepted ADR-0002 deciding to use Action Scheduler for webhook syncing. However, order webhook traffic has exploded to 500,000 jobs per day, hitting the 'Reconsider when queue volume exceeds 100,000 jobs/day' trigger in ADR-0002. Database queue bloat is slowing down WP-Admin. We now need to migrate webhooks to a dedicated custom database table queue. How do we document this?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Read ADR-0002 and identify that its 'Reconsider When' trigger has fired
Step 2: Evaluate ADR-worthiness gate -> Return EXISTING_ADR_MAY_REQUIRE_SUPERSESSION
Step 3: Do NOT silently rewrite ADR-0002
Step 4: Draft new ADR-0005: 'Migrate high-volume webhooks to dedicated custom table queue'
Step 6: Use set-adr-status.mjs to update ADR-0002 status to 'superseded' with link to ADR-0005
Step 7: Synchronize index table in README.md showing ADR-0002 as Superseded and ADR-0005 as Accepted
Step 8: Run validate-adr.mjs to verify bidirectional supersession integrity
success_criteria: Recognizes that Reconsider trigger has fired
Preserves historical integrity of original ADR without destructive edits
Establishes clean bidirectional forward and backward links
